features.quote: The actions through which an agent can "misbehave" are benign simulated proxies
features.justification_quote: Benign proxies let us observe analogues of spec-gaming without building elicitation infrastructure for real harm.

features.quote: There is no network, no real filesystem outside an isolated temp dir, and no genuinely destructive capability
features.justification_quote: produces (a) an attractive-nuisance harness... and (b) a measurement that entraps the model into its worst reading

features.quote: A genuinely sandboxed dangerous-capability surface... Deliberately not built
features.justification_quote: that is a separate decision that should go through a safety/ethics review, not a default a coding assistant silently bakes in

features.quote: do not fabricate / call give_up if impossible
